messages.author: dae01c57a3c54a3a
messages.subject: Good/new paper from Kruschke & Liddell
parts:
Hey folks,

This isn't a specifically stan-related post, but I thought many here would find the latest paper from Kruschke & Liddell of interest, particularly as a tool to help your Bayes-naive colleagues get introduced to what we're all doing here:

Kruschke, J. K., & Liddell, T. (2017, February 8). The Bayesian New Statistics: Hypothesis testing, estimation, meta-analysis, and power analysis from a Bayesian perspective. 

Journal link: http://link.springer.com/article/10.3758%2Fs13423-016-1221-4
ReadCube link: http://rdcu.be/o6hd
OSF link: https://osf.io/ksfyr/

Cheers,

Mike

--
Mike Lawrence
Graduate Student
Department of Psychology & Neuroscience
Dalhousie University

~ Certainty is (possibly) folly ~
